raw_location_policy: All downloaded PDFs, extracted text, renders and exploratory raw files reside only in ignored _local/; excluded from authored manifest.
scope_policy: Listed read scopes describe actual inspection, not download scope. Source authentication does not certify proofs. No source-only or other-family reviews were read.

sources.label: Kjournal
sources.title: On generic flag varieties for odd spin groups

sources.label: DKM
sources.title: Maximal indexes of flag varieties for spin groups
sources.primary_authentication: Official Cambridge PDF, title/author list, journal header and DOI in body. A direct DOI web open errored; direct public publisher PDF retrieval succeeded.
sources.text_read_scope: PDF pp.1-3, including definition and explanation preceding Proposition 2.1, and pp.8-9 even-dimensional introduction through the Spin-torsor/parabolic correspondence. Later invariant computations not audited.
sources.mathematical_role: Generic Chow-image containment gives the required divisibility direction for arbitrary Spin18 forms; characteristic and similarity conventions.

sources.label: EG
sources.title: Localization in equivariant intersection theory and the Bott residue formula
sources.primary_authentication: Fresh arXiv PDF; title, authors and version in PDF body
sources.text_read_scope: Integration formula Corollary 1 and Proposition 5 on printed p.9; web extracts of nearby localization and Bott formulas were also inspected. No complete independent audit of localization theorem proof.
sources.mathematical_role: Standard exact fixed-point integration theorem for one independently authored arithmetic method.

published_input_reproduced: Only sufficient nondivisibility witness and its upper-bound mechanism, by two independently authored arithmetic methods. Full source Schubert expansion not reproduced.
unreproved_inputs: Panin K-theory of twisted flags and split-Clifford quadric restriction properties
Standard Clifford codimension-one and maximal-Grassmannian identifications
The published rationality theorem for ztilde and Chern-subring interpretation
Grassmannian Chow/Schur/Pieri facts and equivariant localization
General Chow-image genericity theorem and associated cycle theory
characteristic_limit: Existence and final counterexample independently specialized to characteristic 0; source arbitrary-characteristic consistency checked, but characteristic 2 foundations not independently reconstructed.
